## What

Describe the resulting behavior. List files with AI-drafted content.

## Why

Link the milestone and relevant ADRs. Quote the milestone exit criteria and
record which were verified (including any deferred or external criteria).

## How it is proven

List tests/properties and exact reproduction commands. Include fixture changes
and evidence that applicable reliability checklist items were reviewed.

## Risk

What could break? Which architecture invariants, bounds, or timeouts matter?

## Rollback

Explain how to undo the change; link migration back-out instructions if relevant.
